integrity: The proof derives every nonlinear codegree from the orbit of a linear character of the cyclic index-two subgroup and treats the invariant-character sector separately. The modular abelianization supplies its linear codegree distribution. A standalone checker verifies the orbit counts and degree-squared identities through order 4096.
scientific_limitations: The classification is internal to the four standard nonabelian 2-group families with a cyclic subgroup of index two.
The dihedral–generalized-quaternion collision is prior to this finding; the additional content is the semidihedral equality and modular contrast completing the four-family picture.
An equivalent codegree table may exist in older representation-theoretic literature without pseudo-algebra terminology.
title: Pseudo-algebras collapse the maximal-class cyclic-index-two 2-groups
